llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: 1) Brand/domain mismatch (Melissa Stewart vs. Boggi Milano), which is a common scam tactic. 2) Lack of legitimate business or contact details, with no About or Contact page visible in hyperlinks. 3) Reports and complaints of non-delivery and refund issues found in web search, with users calling it a scam, matching Fake Online Shopping scam behavior. 4) The product range (luxury and popular brand goods) is typical of fraudulent shops, and there is no verification that the store is an official Boggi Milano retailer. These factors confirm it as a scam online shopping website.
